learning_outcomes.text: Explain the modes of action of essential machine elements.
Determine the strains in mechanical components resulting from statical and dynamical loads.
Dimension the components accordingly for function and claim, with use of CAD.
Solve constructive exercises and document and present the results in a structured elaboration.

syllabus_topics: Design tasks under consideration of the dimensioning and design rules for mechanical engineering components or assemblies
Solution concepts including description of the function
Technical drawings of the assembly with a list of parts and chosen technical drawings of parts
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for participating in the module final exam is passing the study performance, which consists of a written elaboration (5-10 pages) where 3 out of 4 tasks must be passed. The module final exam (120-150 minutes written exam) assesses the ability to solve design tasks, explain machine element functionalities, and dimension components. Credits are awarded upon passing the module final exam.
